answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted proof-of-personhood: each agent must lock a bond and complete a unique biometric attestation verified by independent peers. Duplicate identities are slashed, so an attacker forging N sybils must post N bonds plus pass N costly verifications, making the canyon of cost wider than any glacier of patience. A reputation bridge then carries trust across epochs, letting honest agents compound standing while clones stall at zero. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
